text:
Elodie Wu: Hey y’all 👋 I’m Elodie — first day today, remote from Toronto (EDT). I collect vintage transit maps and tiny LEGO figures. super pumped to join Redwood! Quick q: is there a climbing / bouldering group here? Also any favorite lunch spots near the SF office? I work async a lot so timezone heads-up. :smile:
Maya Chen: welcome Elodie!! :wave: we do a casual climbing meetup sometimes — check #outdoor-club. Lunch-wise, try Saffron Alley or The Melt for quick eats.
Sam Bennett: welcome!! I’ll add you to #outdoor-club now. We’ve got a board-game night on Fridays too if you’re into that. :board_game:
Devon Park: welcome Elodie — curious which keyboard you roll with? mechanical or laptop? also +1 for Saffron Alley.
Elodie Wu: @Sam thanks — would love the board-game night. @Devon I’m a noisy Cherry MX Brown fan (sorry open-office neighbors in advance).
HR Bot: Congrats Elodie! Welcome package (swag, mac charger, plus sticker pack) shipped today — tracking: https://ship.redwood.example/PKG12345. Badge activation: see below.
Sam Bennett: badge scan steps:
```
1) Go to reception
2) Tap badge on the grey reader next to the door
3) If it fails, ping eng-oncall or come find me
```
Elodie Wu: thanks everyone! any tips for onboarding docs I should prioritize? also totally down for sticker swaps. :sticker: 
Maya Chen: onboarding checklist is pinned in #new-hires and in the Welcome doc in Confluence. If you want a quick buddy, I can pair up for the first week.
Devon Park: fwiw, desk plants are allowed (small ones) and we have a fridge label etiquette thread somewhere. also if you bike, there’s a bike rack behind building B.
Elodie Wu: @Maya yes please that would be awesome. thanks again y’all — excited to meet everyone (virtually and in person)! :tada:
